ns2:course.label: Construction Engineering
ns2:course.description: Construction engineering processes: contracting and bonding, planning and scheduling, estimating and project control, productivity models, and construction econometrics. Prerequisite: CEE 201; credit or concurrent registration in CS 101 and CEE 202.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: CEE 201; credit or concurrent registration in CS 101 and CEE 202.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BS:Engr Tech & Mgt Ag Sys-UIUC or BS:Civil Engineering -UIUC.
